stationContext: Stasiun Padalarang is a Whoosh high-speed rail station in Kertajaya, Padalarang, Kabupaten Bandung Barat, Jawa Barat, serving as the interchange hub toward central Bandung via the KA Feeder (reported as 7 feeder trips per day by Kompas). Most nearby hotels and homestays cluster in the Kota Baru Parahyangan (KBP) township and the G-Land Padalarang Residence area a few kilometres from the station.

properties.notes: Public international-brand hotel in Kota Baru Parahyangan, Kertajaya (same kelurahan as the station). Address confirmed by Hilton's own site (seen in search results; direct fetch returned HTTP 403) and independently by Trip.com's structured data for the same property. distanceKm 3.7 is the figure explicitly stated by detikJabar (19 Oct 2026), not map-measured. Trip.com lists a free station pick-up service and check-in 15:00-24:00 / check-out 12:00. detikJabar quotes indicative public rates of Rp1.2-1.3 million/night; these are published consumer rates, not crew/contract rates. No source states room count, capacity, occupancy or any KCIC relationship; classified VERIFIED_PUBLIC, not KCIC-official.

kcicDataRequests: Does KCIC operate or contract any crew accommodation (mess, rumah dinas, dormitory, guesthouse or hotel block) at or near Stasiun Whoosh Padalarang? Provide an official written statement or press release reference.
If yes: official name, full address, coordinates, number of buildings/floors/rooms/beds, capacity, and the operating or contracting entity.

If accommodation is contracted from public hotels (e.g. Hilton Padalarang Bandung, Mason Pine, Hotel Neo KBP): which properties, contract period, allocated room counts, agreed rates, and the KCIC contract owner/contact.
Whether the Gaia Lounge at KCIC Padalarang (opened by The Gaia Hotel Bandung, Feb 2026) has any crew-rest or crew-accommodation function, or is purely a passenger lounge.
Crew rest facilities inside Stasiun Padalarang or connected to Depo Tegalluar operations (if any), with capacity, access rules and whether overnight stays are permitted.
KCIC contact person and department responsible for crew accommodation at the Padalarang end (name, role, phone, email).
Any KCIC-approved transport arrangement between Stasiun Whoosh Padalarang and crew lodging (including the free station pick-up advertised by Hilton), with distances and travel times.
Permission and usage rights for any official KCIC photographs of crew accommodation facilities at Padalarang.
